resources.string:
SolStream Studio optionally uses the Android AccessibilityService API solely to display an assistive floating in-game broadcast control dock (TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY) over full-screen games for one-tap microphone mute, privacy blur shield, scene switching, overlay toggles, clean thumbnail capture, and clip markers.

Microphone & Audio Note:
• Microphone audio is captured separately via Android's standard RECORD_AUDIO permission, and internal game audio uses Android's MediaProjection playback capture when permitted by the game.
• On supported Android versions, keeping this optional overlay active also allows Android's concurrent audio-input rules to operate while broadcasting over games.

Privacy & Security Guarantee:
• SolStream Studio declares isAccessibilityTool="false", canRetrieveWindowContent="false", and canPerformGestures="false", and subscribes to zero accessibility events.
• It CANNOT inspect, read, or collect screen text, passwords, messages, or personal data, and CANNOT perform automated taps or gestures.
• Zero audio, video, or personal data is ever sent to developer servers; all streams go directly to your own configured RTMP/RTMPS server.
• You may decline or disable this service at any time in Android Settings and continue streaming without the floating dock.
